dct_description_sm: All data was collected for a field-mesocosm research experiment examining the effects of road salt on Wood Frog antipredator defences and metamorphosis, conducted at Queen's University Biological Station (QUBS) during the summer of 2024.
dct_title_s: Effects of road salt on anti-predatory defences and metamorphosis of Wood Frogs (Lithobates sylvaticus)
